name: Demonic Possession (Mythic)
body:
You can possess your thralls wherever they are.

Prerequisite(s): Demonic Possession, mythic tier 3rd

Benefit(s): If you already have possessed a creature in the past, are divining a creature through a scrying effect, or are dominating a creature through a spell, a spell-like ability, or a supernatural ability, you can possess that creature regardless of distance, as long as both of you are on the same plane. A dominated creature is not allowed a saving throw against your demonic possession.
